title: The essential attributes of Allah (as-sifat adh-dhatiyyah)
intro: Allah has fourteen perfect attributes. The first six tell us about Allah Himself.

learn.html: Part of the first pillar of Iman is believing that Allah (SWT) has perfect attributes (sifat) that only He has. Through them we know Allah and believe in Him.
Allah has fourteen attributes. The first six are called as-sifat adh-dhatiyyah – the attributes of Allah’s being:

items: Wujud – Allah exists. His existence is lasting – it never passes and never ends.
Wahdaniyyah – Allah is One. There is no god except Allah.
Qidam – Allah has always been. Nobody made Him; He had no beginning.
Baqa – Allah is forever. He will never end.
Mukhalafatun lil-hawadith – Allah is not like anyone or anything. We do not compare Him with anyone or anything.
Qiyamun bi-nafsihi – Allah exists by Himself. He does not need anyone.

learn.alt: A man in sajdah, praying on a mat in a green meadow

learn.title: ⭐ Remember
learn.html: The human mind cannot fully understand Allah’s attributes.

The attributes of Allah’s being tell us about our Creator, Allah (SWT). Each of Allah’s attributes is mentioned in the Qur’an. People must not describe Him in any other way than the way He described Himself.

practice.title: Match the attribute and its meaning

questions.q: How many attributes (sifat) of Allah do we learn?
What are the first six called?
options: As-sifat adh-dhatiyyah – the attributes of Allah’s being
Allah is forever – He will never end

questions.q: Can we compare Allah with someone or something?
options: No – Allah is not like anything
Only the way He described Himself in the Qur’an
The way a film shows Him

practice.title: Choose a task
prompts: ✏️ Learn the six attributes of Allah’s being by heart.
✏️ Make a “cluster” in your notebook: write ALLAH (SWT) in the middle and the six attributes in circles around it.
